mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.email, f.status AS friendStatus FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN im_friend f ON f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.friend_id = u.id WHERE u.id != #{userId} AND (u.status IS NULL OR u.status = 0) AND ( LOWER(u.username) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(u.email) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN LOWER(u.username) = LOWER(#{keyword}) OR LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(#{keyword}) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.username LIMIT 20
